test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are two computer rooms, Lab A and Lab B. If 10 students are sent from Lab A to Lab B, then the number of students in each room will be the same. If 26 students are sent from Lab B to Lab A, then the number of students in Lab A will be triple the number of students in Lab B. The number of students in Lab B is:
solution:
There are two computer rooms, Lab A and Lab B.

Let us consider, 

Students in Lab A = X

Students in Lab B = Y

If 10 students are sent from Lab A to Lab B, then the number of students in each room will be the same.

⇒ X - 10 = Y + 10

⇒ X - Y = 20 ............ (1)

If 26 students are sent from Lab B to Lab A, then the number of students in Lab A will be triple the number of students in Lab B.

⇒ X + 26 = 3(Y - 26)

⇒ X + 26 = 3Y - 78

⇒ X = 3Y - 104 .......... (2)

Substitute eqn (2) in equ (1) So, we get

⇒ X - Y = 20

⇒ 3Y - 104 - Y = 20

⇒ 2Y = 124

⇒ Y = 62

∴ Here, Number of students in Lab B taken as Y = 62

Hence, the correct answer is **"62".**
